findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: base64_decode, countries_bulk · Private data: base64_decode, base64_encode, countries_bulk, mime_lookup, tld_lookup · Public sink: mime_lookup · Destructive: luhn_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: base64_decode, countries_bulk · Private data: base64_decode, base64_encode, countries_bulk, mime_lookup, tld_lookup · Public sink: mime_lookup · Destructive: luhn_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
